viewing_check: Estimate 30-50, current bid $20. The vase is the value: undamaged mid-century Czech or Murano amber/green sommerso vases sold A$47-203 in the last 2.5 years (typical about A$100-125, 9 sales), prices steady to slightly up. Check the base for a polished pontil, signature, labels or chips. Skrdlovice/Beranek pieces glow under UV (uranium) and sell higher (A$126-155). Paperweights Murano-type A$30-79 each when millefiori or latticinio, plain ones A$15-45. Check the photos' paperweights for chips on the base. Vase weighs several kg so postage A$17+.
